about.title: About Me
bio: I'm a Software Engineer focused on distributed systems, cloud architecture, and AI-driven development.
Since 2023 I've been part of Loopay, where I grew from Full Stack Developer to Senior Software Engineer building end-to-end platforms with React, NestJS, and PostgreSQL on AWS and GCP.
Before that, I built hybrid mobile apps and real-time systems at Trebet, transactional BFF and financial risk services at Galgo, and full-stack products at Tribuu Technologies.
I care about clean, modular code — and I practice spec-driven development with AI tooling to ship faster without sacrificing quality.
